environment: Exact Render source exported locally; SQLite disposable learner; browser desktop 1280x720 and main journey 390x844; selected duplicate views 360x800 and 430x932.
limitations: No actual child/young-adult study or physical-phone test. Some source/docs were known before play. Local PostgreSQL and hosted sign-in were not retested. Ratings are whole-number internal diagnostic judgments, not user ratings. Full local browser suite passed but did not catch observed controls failure.
prior_context: Reviewer read product docs and knew the retry contract before play; cannot claim a blind novice test. Workarounds and reloads are recorded.
user_authority: The current user is the sole human product critic and final authority. They requested changes; no new numeric user rating or acceptance was supplied.
design_direction: User selected an ongoing How LLMs Work series. No episode of that series has yet been played or scored.

world_role_stakes.reason: World geography, player identity and immediate stakes depend on explanatory captions.

visible_causality.reason: The first duplicate consequence is offscreen in default phone framing; text supplies the result.

attachment_pull.reason: Pip reaching home offers a concrete payoff, but repeated exposition weakens the visible motivation. Audience appeal is an internal judgment.

orientation_action.reason: The active Forge target is largely outside the first mission frame; marker placement/direction is confusing.

hud_readability.reason: Stacked and duplicated instructions obscure the game; the narrow objective area needs its own scrolling.

controls.reason: Camera/movement buttons stay disabled after saved inspection. A reload restores them; direct camera drag still works.

meaningful_agency.reason: Distinct choices and recoverable errors exist, but later tasks often resolve through the console and generic verdicts.

progression_recovery.reason: The middle signals change technical conditions mostly through prose; the same four-block recipe clears the later transfer.

world_continuity.reason: The 3D world persists through the early signals, but later large construction panels dominate the play area.

concept_fidelity.reason: Authoritative retry semantics have substance, but a stale payload panel contradicts the changed request and visible consequences are weak.

fresh_transfer.reason: The export task changes names/context but accepts the immediately rehearsed four-block sequence. Independent learning was not established.
